vachanas.kannada:
ಮಂಡೆಯ ಬೋಳಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು,
ತೀರ್ಥಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಇಕ್ಕಿಯೆರವವರ ಕಾರುಣ್ಯವಾಗಿ
ಕಡು ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಿಗನಾಗದೆ,
ಹಾರುವನಂತೆ ಲಂಡಕೊಂಡೆಯರ ಕಂಡು,
ಹೊಯಿಹೊಡದಂತಿಪ್ಪ ಶಿವಶರಣರು
ಒರಗಿದಡೆ ಒಲ್ಲರು, ಕಂಡಡರಿಯರು,
ಮಡಿಕೆಯಾಗಿ ಹೊದೆಯರು, ಉಡಿಗೆಯನುಡರು,
ತೊಡಿಗೆಯ ತೊಡರು, ಇಡಿಗೆಯನಿಡರು.
ಕಪ್ಪಕಂಬಳಿಯ ಹೊದ್ದು, ಕುಪ್ಪಸ ನಿಃಪತಿಯಾದ ಶರಣ,
ಗಾರ್ಗೇಶ್ವರಲಿಂಗವು ತಾನೇ ಪರಮ ವಿರತನಾದಿರವು.
vachanas.transliteration:
maṇḍeya bōḷisikoṇḍu,
tīrthakṣētra ikkiyeravavara kāruṇyavāgi
kaḍu śāstriganāgade,
hāruvanante laṇḍakoṇḍeyara kaṇḍu,
hoyihoḍadantippa śivaśaraṇaru
oragidaḍe ollaru, kaṇḍaḍariyaru,
maḍikeyāgi hodeyaru, uḍigeyanuḍaru,
toḍigeya toḍaru, iḍigeyaniḍaru.
kappakambaḷiya hoddu, kuppasa niḥpatiyāda śaraṇa,
gārgēśvaraliṅgavu tānē parama viratanādiravu.
vachanas.translation:
Having shaved the head,
Living on the charity of pilgrims at sacred places,
Without becoming truly disciplined in the profound Śāstras,
Like a bird that swoops upon carrion on seeing loose-haired women,
The true Śiva-śaraṇas do not even lean toward such people, nor do they acknowledge them.
They do not cover themselves for show, nor speak for display.
They do not wear ornaments for appearance, nor keep possessions for pride.
Clad only in a coarse black blanket, with nothing else to claim as his own,
Such a śaraṇa alone is the supreme renunciate—Gārgēśvaraliṅga Himself.
